review.description: Merged all614 stable glossary terms from current main and the development branch, retaining report/evidence/delivery vocabulary alongside plugin inventory, review policy, work status and GitHub budget meanings. Historical adoption identity is unchanged.
review.implementation: Merged terms by stable ID and preserved canonical names, aliases, optional scopes and definition-only ownership. The UI and flow registries consume the combined terms without adding foundation backlinks or implementation procedures.
review.tests: Schema validation reports614 terms and144 entities across16 flows. Existing scoped-name, duplicate-member, dependency-direction and generated-reference tooling assertions remain mapped and are rerun during reconciliation.
